title: Sughra Ne khat Me Likha Tanha Na jee Sakungi
body:
Sughra Ne Khat Me Likha Tanha Na Jee Sakungi
Aajou Mere Baba Tanha Na Jee Sakungi
1.Badhti Hi jaarahi hai Shiddath Mere Maraz Ki
Bechain Hu Main Baba tanha Na Jee Sakungi
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Mehmaan Hu Kuch Hi Dum Ki Aajou Ab Palat Kar
Yeh Dil Hai Para Para Tanha Na Jee Sakungi
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Nazdeek Aagayi Hu Main Mout Ke Bhot Ab
Marjaungi Main Baba Tanha Na Jee Sakungi
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Tham Jaiengi Yeh Saansein Ro Ro Ke Kuch Hi Dum Me
Sach Kehrahi Hu Baba Tanha Na Jee Sakungi
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Jabse Gaye Hu Baba Ro Ro Ke Sune Ghar Me
Dum Ghut Raha Hai Mera Tanha Na Jee Sakungi
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Le Jao Aakey Akber Is Gham Zada Behan Ku
Tumse Bichadh Ke Bhaiya Tanha Na Jee Sakungi
<<DIVIDER>>
7.Har Waqt Mere Dil Ku Kunbe Se Chootne Ka
Tadhpa Raha Hai Sadma Tanha Na Jee Sakungi
<<DIVIDER>>
8.Karti Na Koi Shikwa Asghar Jo Ghar Me Hota
Kat Jaata Waqt Mere Tanha Na Jee Sakungi
<<DIVIDER>>
9.Meri Phuphi Se Maa Se Khehdijiye Chacha Se
Aajou Ghar Khudara Tanha Na Jee Sakungi
<<DIVIDER>>
10.Aajou Tum Jo Baba Raunaq Palat Ke Aaye
Veraan Hai Madina Tanha Na Jee Sakungi
<<DIVIDER>>
11.Ansou Thame Na Mazhar Ankhou Se Shah-e-Deen Ke
